author: Ari Koslow
title: Jared Koenig (elbow) to be activated Friday
desc: Jared Koenig will be activated from the injured list on Friday.
impact: Koenig is set to make his return this weekend. Craig Yoho was optioned on Thursday to make room.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Craig Yoho optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Brewers optioned Craig Yoho to Triple-A Nashville.
impact: Yoho will return to Triple-A with Jared Koenig getting activated on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ernie Clement (hip) back in lineup Thursday
desc: Ernie Clement is back in the Blue Jays lineup on Thursday against the Rangers.
impact: Clement returns from a two-game absence. He is back at shortstop and batting second.

author: Nate Miller
title: Colton Gordon sent back to minors
desc: Colton Gordon was optioned to Triple-A ahead of Thursday's game agains the Tigers.
impact: Gordon's most recent stay in the majors turned out to be a short one, as he was just recalled on Wednesday. The lefty will head back to Triple-A, as reliever Bryan Abreu was reinstated from the restricted list.

author: Nate Miller
title: Bryan Abreu (restricted) rejoins Astros on Thursday
desc: Bryan Abreu was reinstated from the restricted list ahead of Thursday's game against the Tigers.
impact: Abreu was placed on the restricted list on Monday due to an undisclosed personal matter. The righty last pitched for the Astros this past Saturday, but it looks like he will be back in the bullpen in time for Thursday's game. Colton Gordon was optioned back to the minors in a corresponding move.

author: Nate Miller
title: Corey Seager (concussion) officially back with Rangers
desc: Corey Seager (concussion) was activated from the IL ahead of Thursday's game against the Blue Jays.
impact: The expectation was that Seager would return to the Rangers' lineup on Thursday, and that has turned out to be the case. The five-time All-Star has been out of action for the last two weeks due to concussion symptoms. Cody Freeman (back) was placed on the IL in a corresponding move.

author: Nate Miller
title: Cody Freeman (back) lands on IL
desc: Cody Freeman (back) was placed on the IL ahead of Thursday's game against the Blue Jays.
impact: Freeman's IL stay is retroactive to June 22. The young utility man is reportedly dealing with a herniated disc. Veteran shortstop Corey Seager (concussion) has been activated from the IL in a corresponding move.

author: Chris Schommer
title: William Contreras goes yard in win over Reds
desc: William Contreras went 3-for-3 in Wednesday's win over the Reds with a home run, two runs scored, two RBI, and one walk.
impact: Contreras has heated back up at the plate, collecting hits in four of his last five contests. The 28-year-old continues to reward fantasy managers with one of the more stable options in a streaky Brewers lineup, batting .302 with eight home runs, 48 RBI, 45 runs scored, and one stolen base across 74 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jake Bauers goes deep in win over Reds
desc: Jake Bauers went 2-for-4 in Wednesday's win over the Reds with a home run, two runs scored, one RBI, and one walk.
impact: Bauers has provided mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in six of his last 11 contests. The 30-year-old continues flash his power stroke while remaining one of the more streaky options in the Brewers lineup, carrying an .885 OPS with 14 home runs, 48 RBI, five stolen bases, and 45 runs scored across 69 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Blaze Jordan drives in three as Cards fall
desc: Blaze Jordan went 2-for-3 in a loss to the Diamondbacks with a double and three RBI.
impact: After Wednesday's loss, Jordan is batting .286 with one home run, 12 RBI, and five runs scored through 12 games. He's made two appearances at first base, with the rest coming at the hot corner. He's swinging and missing barely at all, but isn't making great contact. Still, he should see plenty of playing time to figure it out.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Andrew Vaughn drives in three in win over Reds
desc: Andrew Vaughn went 1-for-1 in a win over the Reds with a three-run double.
impact: Vaughn has been productive at the plate of late, driving in runs in four of his last seven contests. The first baseman continues to reward manager Pat Murphy with another dynamic option when in the Brewers lineup, batting .351 with two home runs, 24 RBI, and 16 runs scored across 40 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Jose Fermin pops a homer, swipes a bag in loss
desc: Jose Fermin went 2-for-3 in Wednesday's 9-4 loss to the Diamondbacks with a home run, three runs scored, one RBI, one stolen base and one walk.
impact: Fermin is now batting .277 with three homers, 15 RBI, 13 runs, and three steals across 45 games. He's started only one of his team's last 10 games against a righty.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Shane Drohan grinds through abbreviated outing in win over Reds
desc: Shane Drohan allowed five hits and three walks while striking out five over 4 1/3 scoreless innings in Wednesday's win over the Reds.
impact: Drohan continues a solid stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in each of his last five starts. The left-hander has offered manager Pat Murphy a mostly stable option on the Brewers pitching staff, posting a 3.12 ERA and 1.23 WHIP with a 3-2 record and 9.0 K/9 ratio through 16 appearances.

author: Chase Davis
title: Matthew Liberatore gets tagged for six as Cards fall 9-4
desc: Matthew Liberatore allowed six earned runs on eight hits and two walks while striking out three over 5.1 innings in Wednesday's loss to the Diamondbacks.
impact: After the loss, Liberatore now carries a 5.56 ERA and 1.58 WHIP with an 8.1 K/9, and a 3-5 record across 16 starts. He gave up four hard-hit balls and picked up seven whiffs on 98 pitches. He's been knocked around for 11 earned runs in his last two starts, spanning seven innings. He can't be trusted next time out against the Braves.

author: Chris Schommer
title: David Bednar nails down another save in win over Tigers
desc: David Bednar struck out one batter while allowing one hit in a scoreless outing to earn the save in Wednesday's 4-2 win over the Tigers.
impact: Bednar continues an impressive stretch out of the bullpen, recording his eleventh consecutive scoreless appearance in the win. The right-hander has offered manager Aaron Boone one of the more stable options out of the Yankees bullpen, posting a 3.27 ERA and 1.27 WHIP with 16 saves and a 10.6 K/9 ratio across 32 appearances.
